hooks.text: 每回合先掷骰并分配给行动，满足骰子要求就必定按描述执行
hooks.excerpt: Characters roll their dice at the start of their turn, which they can then use to power their various actions. There are no hit-or-miss systems in Dobbel Dungeon. Instead, as long as you have the required dice, your actions will execute exactly as described, giving you the opportunity to carefully plan around your rolls each turn!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 从三名独特英雄组队，途中营救新英雄并获取定义构筑的道具
hooks.excerpt: Begin each adventure by selecting a party of 3 heroes, each with their own unique skill set and playstyle, before venturing out into the wild. Rescue new heroes along the way, find powerful build-defining items and spend your hard-earned gold at that little shop whose owner you just saved from certain doom!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 用任务获得的共享技能点在三名英雄技能树间取舍，失败后可重做全新构筑
hooks.excerpt: With every quest and bonus objective you complete, you will gain valuable skill points to distribute amongst your heroes’ skill trees. As you invest more points into a hero, more powerful skills will become available. Skill points are a shared commoddity though, so spend them wisely! And if your build didn’t pan out this time, you can always try something completely different in your next adventure!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
